# <span id="aanchor320"></span> Comparison Location Editor

[&lt;&lt; Back](Comparison%20Location.md) \| <a href="#" class="ExceptionHeading selected">Configuration</a> \| [Validation](Comparison%20Location%20Editor%20-%20Validation%20Tab.md)

## Configuration Tab

The following items are available on the Configuration tab:

- **Check and Custody object selectors** - Select designations for the check and custody measurements. They may be meters, locations or a mix of the two.

- **Calculation** - Define the calculation used to provide the comparative amount and percentage. This is not an absolute value.

  To define the comparison calculation, set the numerator to determine the difference. The choices are either: (Check - Custody) or (Custody - Check). This essentially determines the sign of the result. Positive values represent the user's maximum validation, while negative values represent the user's minimum validation. Set the denominator to determine if the result is a percentage of the check measurement or a percentage of the custody measurement.

  Meter and location directions will not be factored into the comparison. An inlet can be compared to another inlet or to an outlet. The sign will be determined by this definition.

- **Reference Meter** - A comparison location requires a reference meter to determine contract day and hour. The reference meter does not have to be a meter that is used in the calculation.
